summary: Section 11, the construction-phase workforce plan, from the first community contribution.

changes.text: Section 11 — plan the construction phase before the first truck arrives. Seven requirements: workforce curve disclosure, staging and laydown siting, delivery and shift timing, funded transit, road baseline plus remediation bond before mobilization, a named accountable workforce manager under a code of conduct, and EMS funding tied to measured call load. Proposed in the public discussion of the source post.
Evidence item for the section's central claim, uncited until the contributor's public-case reference is attached.
"What will be built?" and "What will it consume?" now count Section 11 in their readiness.
